run_doxygen_to_qbk: run make_qbk.py to convert Boost.Geometry Doxygen XML output into QuickBook qbk documentation files
run_call_doxygen: run the call_doxygen function to invoke Doxygen and generate XML documentation in the doxy directory
run_group_to_quickbook: run group_to_quickbook to convert a Doxygen group section like area or buffer into a qbk file
run_strategy_to_quickbook: run strategy_to_quickbook to convert a namespaced strategy section like area::cartesian into a qbk file
run_remove_all_files: run remove_all_files to recursively clean a directory of generated Doxygen intermediate XML and HTML files
